name: beatpilot
description: Generative music that plays while you code. Eight genres of real-time ChucK synthesis (techno, dnb, lofi, reggae, dub, goa, piano, ambient) with optional CC0 sample blends. Music evolves based on what your AI assistant is doing — prompts, tool calls, agents, and errors shape the key, scale, energy, and melody.

genre.title: Genre
genre.description: Which engine plays: techno, dnb, lofi, reggae, dub, goa, piano or ambient

statusLine.title: Now playing in the status line
statusLine.description: Show genre, key, energy and bar in the status line

band.title: Play bar above the prompt
band.description: A one-line bar above the prompt with the 16-bar phrase and a pause/play button

tunePerPrompt.title: New tune per prompt
tunePerPrompt.description: Each new prompt gets its own key and melody (applied at the next phrase). Off: one tune per project

headless.title: Play in headless sessions
headless.description: Also play during claude -p and SDK runs
